I don’t keep track exactly, but I know it’s been longer than a few rough months. I work as a bank teller, and it’s getting harder to focus—numbers blur, customers repeat themselves, and I catch myself zoning out mid-transaction. I used to take pride in my accuracy, but now I second-guess every deposit.  

I don’t know if it’s laziness or something else, but I can’t seem to care as much anymore. The things that used to matter—my appearance, staying on top of bills, even calling my mom—just feel pointless. Sometimes I wonder if I’m just broken. Like I’m not as strong or as good as other people. I haven’t had any major crashes—no days where I couldn’t get out of bed—but it’s this steady hum of emptiness.  

After my divorce, I thought things might pick up. They didn’t. I don’t know if this is just who I am now or if it’s something that could change. I just get by.
